release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.16 - Reply, React & Enhanced Features:
- ✨ NEW: Reply to messages in individual and group chats
- ✨ NEW: React to messages with emoji reactions
- ✨ NEW: Full offline support for reactions on local network web
- ✨ NEW: Device tracking for all platforms (Android, iOS, Web)
- ✨ NEW: Admin panel device statistics and management
- ✨ NEW: IPv4 address tracking for web devices
- 🎨 Enhanced light and dark mode UI across all screens
- 📱 Fully responsive design for all screens and admin panel
- 🔔 Unread message count badge beside red dot indicator
- 🔔 FCM push notifications for all platforms (iOS, Android, Web)
- 🔔 FCM notifications sent to offline users automatically
- ✅ Improved unread count reset when opening chats
- ✅ Enhanced chat list refresh after returning from chat
- ✅ Better unread message detection and display
- ✅ Platform-specific routing (Web -> Local Network, Mobile -> Ngrok)
- ✅ Improved message marking as read functionality
- ✅ Real-time reaction updates via Socket.IO with polling fallback
- ✅ Reactions work fully offline on local network web
